question: How many customers are there?
reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers

question: How many customers live in the state of Minas Gerais (MG)?
reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers WHERE customer_state = 'MG'

question: How many customers have placed more than one order?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING count(*) > 1) t

question: Which 3 cities have the most customers? Give each city and its number of customers, from most to least.
reference_sql: SELECT customer_city, count(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers GROUP BY customer_city ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the total of all payments (payment_value) for orders that contain at least one product from the 'beleza_saude' category, whatever the order status?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(payment_value) FROM order_payments WHERE order_id IN (SELECT i.order_id FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name = 'beleza_saude')

question: Across all orders, what are the total freight value of the items and the total amount paid? Give both numbers.
reference_sql: SELECT (SELECT sum(freight_value) FROM order_items), (SELECT sum(payment_value) FROM order_payments)

question: What is the average review score of orders that include at least one product from the 'cama_mesa_banho' category? Round to two decimals.
reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(review_score), 2) FROM order_reviews WHERE order_id IN (SELECT i.order_id FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name = 'cama_mesa_banho')

question: What is the average total amount paid per order? Round to two decimals.
reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(total), 2) FROM (SELECT order_id, sum(payment_value) AS total FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id) t

question: How many orders include at least one product from the 'esporte_lazer' category?
reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT i.order_id) FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name = 'esporte_lazer'

question: How many orders include at least one item from a seller located in the state of Rio de Janeiro (RJ)?
reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT i.order_id) FROM order_items i JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id WHERE s.seller_state = 'RJ'

question: How many reviews have a score of 1?
reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT review_id) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 1

question: How many orders were delivered to the customer in 2017?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date >= '2017-01-01' AND order_delivered_customer_date < '2018-01-01'
acceptable_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date >= '2017-01-01' AND order_delivered_customer_date < '2018-01-01'

question: In which month of 2017 (as a number from 1 to 12) were the most orders delivered to customers, and how many?
reference_sql: SELECT extract(month FROM order_delivered_customer_date)::int, count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date >= '2017-01-01' AND order_delivered_customer_date < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were approved in January 2018?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_approved_at >= '2018-01-01' AND order_approved_at < '2018-02-01'

question: How many orders were there in the first quarter of 2018?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01'

question: How many items from the 'informatica_acessorios' category were sold?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name = 'informatica_acessorios' AND o.order_status = 'delivered'

question: What was the total sales revenue in 2017, counting item prices only (without freight)?
reference_sql: SELECT sum(i.price) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'

question: Which seller has sold the most items? Give the seller_id and the number of items sold.
reference_sql: SELECT i.seller_id, count(*) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY i.seller_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which product category had the highest sales revenue (sum of item prices)? Give the category and the revenue.
reference_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, sum(i.price) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1
acceptable_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, sum(i.price) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average number of installments for credit card payments? Round to two decimals.
reference_sql: SELECT round(avg(payment_installments), 2) FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

question: How many products have no category?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL

question: How many orders contain items from more than one seller?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING count(DISTINCT seller_id) > 1) t
